classes.name: HandoffLifecycleModule
classes.description: Sekai-owned deep module whose interface owns Handoff manifest invariants, replay identity, timestamp validation, predecessor compatibility, durable creation, and revocation authority.

classes.name: SekaiGrpcTransportAdapter
classes.description: gRPC adapter that authenticates Handoff callers, authorizes namespace access, evaluates reference visibility, maps protocol messages, and delegates durable lifecycle behavior.

classes.name: HandoffManifest
classes.description: Versioned immutable manifest that transfers bounded context references between principals without copying content or granting access.

relations.name: delegates_handoff_lifecycle_to
relations.description: The gRPC transport delegates creation and revocation ordering to the Handoff lifecycle module after authentication and namespace authorization.

relations.name: governs_handoff_manifest
relations.description: The Handoff lifecycle module governs durable creation and revocation of Handoff manifests.
